citations.claim: first in_arena violation: body 0 centre x=19.05 with r=1.17 extends 0.22 beyond x=20 boundary
one step before, body already touches/passes boundary (x+r>20) but vx stays +35.2 with no bounce

counterfactual.change: reduce dt from 0.00596 to 0.001 (one field); finer integration restores the right-boundary bounce so no in_arena violation in 75 steps

explanation: Body 0 gains vx~35.2 after early collisions and flies to the right boundary. At step 74 its edge already exceeds x=20 yet vx is unchanged (+35.21) and it exits further by step 75, i.e. boundary contact produced no impulse/reflection at this dt. Reducing only dt to 0.001 eliminates the failure, indicating discrete boundary-collision handling misses the impact at high speed/coarse dt.
vision_note: The red circle moves steadily rightward toward the boundary from step 72 to 74 and then ends up halfway outside the right wall at step 75 without rebounding. The blue circle stays on the left while the red body passes through the arena edge and leaves the arena.
